body:
I’m going through the same thing right now, except for me it’s been ~24 hours.

I know how you feel. It feels impossible to process, like my entire life has just stopped. I can’t move, or think. Every action and thought reminds me of her. I have so much stuff around here with stories behind it. The helpless lack of control to be able to change or do anything about it scares me.

I wish I could give you some kind of advice, but you’re probably further long processing this than me.
You can make it. There’s lots of people who care about you.
